title: Cross-Product Diversity Score
scenario: Calculate the diversity score: (Number of distinct products bought) / (Total number of items bought). Return 'customer_id' and 'diversity_score'.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS diversity_score FROM customer GROUP BY customer_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE customer (customer_id INT, product_key INT); INSERT INTO customer VALUES (1, 5), (1, 5), (1, 6);
